# Overlays

*Describes silverpoint 0.7.0.*

Modal, Drawer, Popover, Tooltip, Select, DropdownMenu and Toast are built on the platform's
`<dialog>` and Popover API. They are client components only.

## The trigger is a native button

Give every overlay a native `<button type="button">` as its trigger:

- **React:** the `trigger` prop, `trigger={<button type="button">Edit</button>}`. The overlay
  clones it with its ARIA and its toggle. Do not pass `SpButton`: it drops the ARIA it is given.
- **Vue:** the `trigger` slot, `<template #trigger><button type="button">Edit</button></template>`.
  Its first element is cloned.
- **Angular:** project the button with the `spTrigger` directive,
  `<button type="button" spTrigger>Edit</button>`, and import `SpTrigger` from the overlay's own
  subpath.

## Open state

| | Controlled | Uncontrolled | Change |
|---|---|---|---|
| React | `open` | `defaultOpen` | `onOpenChange(open)` |
| Vue | `v-model:open` | `default-open` | `update:open` |
| Angular | `[(open)]` | `[defaultOpen]` | `(openChange)` |

`onOpenChange` also fires when the platform closes it: Escape, or a click outside. A Modal with
`dismissible={false}` ignores both.

## Toasts

Put one `SpToaster` near the root and render `SpToast` children inside it. A toast closes after the
toaster's `duration` (5000 ms) unless its own `duration` says otherwise. It pauses while hovered or
focused, and F8 moves focus to the toaster.

## Sides

Sides are logical, `start` and `end`, so they mirror in right-to-left pages. Reflex's `left` and
`right` become `start` and `end`.

**Contents:** [SpModal](#spmodal) · [SpDrawer](#spdrawer) · [SpPopover](#sppopover) · [SpTooltip](#sptooltip) · [SpSelect](#spselect) · [SpDropdownMenu](#spdropdownmenu) · [SpToast](#sptoast)

## SpModal

`modal` · A modal dialog on the native `<dialog>`, opened by its trigger. (overlays)

|  | React | Vue | Angular | Reflex |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Name | `SpModal` | `SpModal` | `sp-modal` | `sp_modal` |
| Import | `@silverpoint/react/ui/modal` | `@silverpoint/vue/ui/modal` | `@silverpoint/angular/ui/modal` | `reflex_silverpoint_react` |

**Open state:** React `open + onOpenChange`, Vue `v-model:open`, Angular `[(open)]`.

**Events:** React `onOpenChange`; Vue ; Angular .

**Content:** React `children`, `footer`, `trigger`; Vue `default`, `footer`, `trigger`; Angular `content`, `spFooter`, `spTrigger`.

**States:** `open`.

### Props

Its own props, beside the common ones (`id`, `seed`, `ground`, `substrate`, `mode`, `palette`, `size`, `className`).

| Prop | Type | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `title` | `string` |  | The heading, `${id}--title`, that names the dialog. |
| `description` | `string` |  | A paragraph, `${id}--description`, that describes the dialog. |
| `label` | `string` |  | Accessible name without a title (REQ-501). |
| `closable` | `boolean` | `true` | Default `true`. |
| `closeLabel` | `string` | `'Close'` | Default `'Close'`. |
| `width` | `string` | `'520px'` | CSS length. Default `'520px'` (from `ui.css`). |
| `dismissible` | `boolean` | `true` | Escape and a backdrop click close it. Default `true`. |

### Example

```tsx
import '@silverpoint/fonts/fonts.css';
import '@silverpoint/grounds/styles.css';
import '@silverpoint/grounds/ui.css';
import { SpModal } from '@silverpoint/react/ui/modal';

export function ModalView() {
  return (
    <SpModal
      title="Edit order"
      description="Order 1042, placed on 14 October."
      trigger={<button type="button">Edit order</button>}
    >
      Changes reach the workshop before the order is packed.
    </SpModal>
  );
}
```

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import '@silverpoint/fonts/fonts.css';
import '@silverpoint/grounds/styles.css';
import '@silverpoint/grounds/ui.css';
import { SpModal } from '@silverpoint/vue/ui/modal';
</script>

<template>
  <SpModal
    title="Edit order"
    description="Order 1042, placed on 14 October."
  >
    <template #trigger><button type="button">Edit order</button></template>
    Changes reach the workshop before the order is packed.
  </SpModal>
</template>
```

```ts angular
import { ChangeDetectionStrategy, Component } from '@angular/core';
import { SpModal, SpTrigger } from '@silverpoint/angular/ui/modal';

/** Add '@silverpoint/fonts/fonts.css', '@silverpoint/grounds/styles.css', '@silverpoint/grounds/ui.css' to the `styles` of angular.json. */
@Component({
  selector: 'app-modal-view',
  imports: [SpModal, SpTrigger],
  changeDetection: ChangeDetectionStrategy.OnPush,
  template: `
    <sp-modal
      [title]="'Edit order'"
      [description]="'Order 1042, placed on 14 October.'"
    >
      <button type="button" spTrigger>Edit order</button>
      Changes reach the workshop before the order is packed.
    </sp-modal>
  `,
})
export class ModalView {}
```

## SpDrawer

`drawer` · A dialog sliding in from one side of the viewport. (overlays)

|  | React | Vue | Angular | Reflex |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Name | `SpDrawer` | `SpDrawer` | `sp-drawer` | `sp_drawer` |
| Import | `@silverpoint/react/ui/drawer` | `@silverpoint/vue/ui/drawer` | `@silverpoint/angular/ui/drawer` | `reflex_silverpoint_react` |

**Open state:** React `open + onOpenChange`, Vue `v-model:open`, Angular `[(open)]`.

**Events:** React `onOpenChange`; Vue ; Angular .

**Content:** React `children`, `footer`, `trigger`; Vue `default`, `footer`, `trigger`; Angular `content`, `spFooter`, `spTrigger`.

**States:** `end-open`.

### Props

Its own props, beside the common ones (`id`, `seed`, `ground`, `substrate`, `mode`, `palette`, `size`, `className`).

| Prop | Type | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `side` | `'start' \| 'end' \| 'top' \| 'bottom'` | `'end'` | Default `'end'`. |
| `extent` | `string` | `'380px'` | CSS length across the side. Default `'380px'` (start/end) or `'320px'` (top/bottom). |
| `modal` | `boolean` | `true` | `false` opens with `show()`. Default `true`. |


## SpSelect

`select` · A select-only combobox: one option from a list. (overlays)

|  | React | Vue | Angular | Reflex |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Name | `SpSelect` | `SpSelect` | `sp-select` | `sp_select` |
| Import | `@silverpoint/react/ui/select` | `@silverpoint/vue/ui/select` | `@silverpoint/angular/ui/select` | `reflex_silverpoint_react` |

**Value:** React `value + onChange`, Vue `v-model`, Angular `[(value)]`.

**Open state:** React `open + onOpenChange`, Vue `v-model:open`, Angular `[(open)]`.

**Events:** React `onChange`, `onOpenChange`; Vue ; Angular .

**States:** `placeholder`, `open-selected`.

### Props

Its own props, beside the common ones (`id`, `seed`, `ground`, `substrate`, `mode`, `palette`, `size`, `className`).

| Prop | Type | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `items` | `readonly (string \| UiItem)[]` |  | **Required.** A string is its own key and label. |
| `placeholder` | `string` | `'Select…'` | Default `'Select…'`. |
| `label` | `string` |  | **Required.** Accessible name of the combobox. |
| `disabled` | `boolean` |  | Not focusable and not submitted. |
| `required` | `boolean` |  | Sets `aria-required` on the combobox. |
| `name` | `string` |  | Submits the key under this name, from a hidden input (REQ-323). |
| `width` | `string` | `'180px'` | CSS length. Default `'180px'` (from `ui.css`). |

### Example

```tsx
import '@silverpoint/fonts/fonts.css';
import '@silverpoint/grounds/styles.css';
import '@silverpoint/grounds/ui.css';
import { useState } from 'react';
import { SpSelect } from '@silverpoint/react/ui/select';

export function SelectView() {
  const [value, setValue] = useState<string | undefined>(undefined);
  return (
    <SpSelect
      label="Status"
      name="status"
      items={[{ key: 'placed', label: 'Placed' }, { key: 'paid', label: 'Paid' }, { key: 'packed', label: 'Packed' }, { key: 'shipped', label: 'Shipped' }, { key: 'returned', label: 'Returned', disabled: true }]}
      value={value}
      onChange={setValue}
    />
  );
}
```

```vue

import '@silverpoint/grounds/styles.css';

    v-model="value"
```

```ts angular
import { ChangeDetectionStrategy, Component, signal } from '@angular/core';
import { SpSelect } from '@silverpoint/angular/ui/select';

/** Add '@silverpoint/fonts/fonts.css', '@silverpoint/grounds/styles.css', '@silverpoint/grounds/ui.css' to the `styles` of angular.json. */
@Component({
  selector: 'app-select-view',
  imports: [SpSelect],
  changeDetection: ChangeDetectionStrategy.OnPush,
  template: `
    <sp-select
      [label]="'Status'"
      [name]="'status'"
      [items]="[{ key: 'placed', label: 'Placed' }, { key: 'paid', label: 'Paid' }, { key: 'packed', label: 'Packed' }, { key: 'shipped', label: 'Shipped' }, { key: 'returned', label: 'Returned', disabled: true }]"
      [(value)]="value"
    />
  `,
})
export class SelectView {
  protected readonly value = signal<string | undefined>(undefined);
}
```

## SpToast

`toast` · A transient message in a `SpToaster`, with an optional action. (overlays)

|  | React | Vue | Angular | Reflex |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Name | `SpToast` | `SpToast` | `sp-toast` | `sp_toast` |
| Import | `@silverpoint/react/ui/toast` | `@silverpoint/vue/ui/toast` | `@silverpoint/angular/ui/toast` | `reflex_silverpoint_react` |

**Open state:** React `open + onOpenChange`, Vue `v-model:open`, Angular `[(open)]`.

**Events:** React `onOpenChange`; Vue ; Angular .

**Content:** React `action`; Vue `action`; Angular `spAction`.

**States:** `info`, `error-action`.

### Props

Its own props, beside the common ones (`id`, `seed`, `ground`, `substrate`, `mode`, `palette`, `size`, `className`).

| Prop | Type | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `title` | `string` |  | **Required.** The toast's first line. |
| `description` | `string` |  | A line under the title. |
| `kind` | `AlertKind` | `'info'` | Default `'info'`. |
| `duration` | `number` |  | ms, at least 1000, or `Infinity`; the toaster's when omitted. |
| `closeLabel` | `string` | `'Dismiss'` | Default `'Dismiss'`. |

### Example

```tsx
import '@silverpoint/fonts/fonts.css';
import '@silverpoint/grounds/styles.css';
import '@silverpoint/grounds/ui.css';
import { useState } from 'react';
import { SpToast } from '@silverpoint/react/ui/toast';

export function ToastView() {
  const [open, setOpen] = useState<boolean>(true);
  return (
    <SpToast
      kind="info"
      title="Order saved"
      description="Order 1042 was updated."
      open={open}
      onOpenChange={setOpen}
    />
  );
}
```
